about.description: Membrane Finance issues a fiat-backed stablecoin maintained at parity with its reference currency through reserve backing and redemption mechanisms. It enables fast, low-cost settlement of stablecoin transactions.
about.registryInfo: Membrane Finance - EU-regulated issuer of the EUROe euro stablecoin, operating under an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licence issued by the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority (FIN-FSA).
